outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models with mean ± SD bars, and individual data points (colored dots for each biological replicate) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel B is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow (Ad-Cre administration, MRI, harvest), not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographs of mice, not a plot presenting averaged data.
Panel D consists of representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a quantitative plot.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a plot presenting averaged data.
